metadata.method: Sequential, interleaved old/new; alternate order by block and round; 12 warmup blocks/network; inputs in RAM; GC disabled; validation outside timers.
metadata.proposal_flow: Decode unsigned production response -> header -> attach original signature -> publish encoding -> block root. Fulu contents are constructed from real blocks with empty blobs/proofs because these are absent from the corpus. Gloas uses original unsigned block.
